design: Compact lean young adult guard. Copper-red mottled hide, exposed curious mandible face with high arched crown and short upward swept dreadlock crest with longer back locks. Sleeveless diagonal-crossed dark leather cuirass with small bronze center clasp, one crescent-shaped pauldron, mesh upper legs, short split black hip tunic, long bandaged shins. Carries a closed collapsible combistick horizontally at waist in one hand and a small curved biomask clipped at left hip. Casual one-foot-ahead patrol pause.
